data.name: Chikun
data.gender_notes: Chikun is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Chakra', meaning circle. In Hindu mythology, the mouse is a symbol of Ganesha, the elephant-headed god who is the remover of obstacles. The name 'Chikun' could be derived from 'Chikura' or 'Chikku', which means 'mouse' in various Indian languages. The name Chikun carries the meaning “Little Mouse” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Chikun usually hope their child will grow to embody little mouse and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the qualities of agility, adaptability, and determination. The mouse is considered a powerful totem animal in Hinduism, and the name 'Chikun' can bring these qualities into your life.
data.etymology: Chikun belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Little Mouse.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Chikun total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
